acceptance_gate.condition: fraction(a)>0.5 -> generation/perception gap CONFIRMED; fraction(b)>0.3 -> search/lookahead lever RE-OPENED; fraction(c)>0.3 -> selection/ranking gap CONFIRMED (pre-registered, decisive in every branch, per arc-top-project-search-architecture-audit-2026-07-20.md section 4)
acceptance_gate.principle: Unlike a level-gain delta (which returns 'no change' on a near-zero-headroom corpus and cannot distinguish 'component useless' from 'no headroom'), this is a structural attribution with no delta to be null on -- it can only localize the gap.

duration_note: Real, non-mocked offline replay across 3 games, 155 total progress-actions classified.

acceptance_gate.principle: Pre-registered thresholds (0.5 for (a), 0.3 for (b) and (c)) were fixed in the design note BEFORE this run, not tuned to the result.

inference_substrate_note: Pure offline replay of pre-existing, reproduction-gated banked trajectories (results/arc_loop_solve_<game>.json) against the live candidate generator (arc_graph_explore.rich_action_candidates) -- no LLM call, no GPU, no sampling anywhere in this script.
per_action_detail_path: see per_game[].per_action_count; full per-action records omitted from top-level summary for size -- written separately below

excluded.sc25: no registered GameAdapter (adapters.get_adapter('sc25') is None); its banked plan uses a bespoke label DSL requiring a separate decoder, out of scope for this pass

random_seed_note: N/A -- deterministic replay of fixed banked action sequences; the bootstrap CI uses a fixed content-hash-seeded LCG, not wall-clock randomness, so the whole run is exactly reproducible given the same banked trajectory inputs.
